About the Doctor
Dr. Iftekhar Khan
MBBS, MD Dermatology · AIIMS Delhi

Dr. Iftekhar Khan is an experienced dermatologist specializing in skin, hair, laser, and aesthetic treatments. He focuses on accurate diagnosis and personalized care to deliver safe, natural, and long-lasting results. His approach is patient-first — every treatment plan is tailored to each individual's unique needs.
